posts.body_html:
Eric: these are very much like carnivorous plants: they like nutrient poor soils, and can't be grown in regular soil. I have them growing in pure sphagnum moss, and have to transplant them every year because the sphagnum breaks down, and they start to decline when in mushy, old soil. Below are some recent photos.
